learning_outcomes.text: The student knows the foundations and basic concepts of biomedical data analysis and can apply them in the domain of biomedical signal and image processing.
The student knows the basic concepts of statistics and machine learning.
The student knows how to correctly select data science methodologies to apply to problems in biomedical engineering.
The student can call the methods in Python and correctly apply them to practical problems in biomedical signal and image processing.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to biomedical signals (ECG, EEG, EMG, accelerometry, bioimpedance,…) and images (X-ray, CT, MRI, PET, …)
Estimation theory with applications in biomedical data analysis: Fisher information
Estimation theory with applications in biomedical data analysis: Cramér-Rao lower bound, U-statistics
Estimation theory with applications in biomedical data analysis: bootstrapping
Estimation theory with applications in biomedical data analysis: Maximum Likelihood
Hypothesis tests for machine learning and biostatistics: Concepts - P-values
Hypothesis tests for machine learning and biostatistics: Wilcoxon test and permutation tests
Hypothesis tests for machine learning and biostatistics: Rank-tests such as the Mann-Whitney U test, Kruskal-Wallis and other non-parametric tests
Hypothesis tests for machine learning and biostatistics: Bonferroni correction in the case of multiple comparisons
Hypothesis tests for machine learning and biostatistics: Goodness-of-fit tests
Hypothesis tests for machine learning and biostatistics: Power analysis
Classic machine learning methods: Nearest neighbors
Classic machine learning methods: Decision trees
Classic machine learning methods: Bias-variance decomposition
Linear models and optimization: Logistic regression
Linear models and optimization: Tikhonov regularization
Linear models and optimization: Gradient descent
Linear models and optimization: Learning rate, training curves
Linear models and optimization: Stochastic gradient descent
Linear models and optimization: Metrics for classification and regression
Neural networks: Multi-layer perceptrons
Neural networks: Convolutional networks
Neural networks: Backpropagation
Neural networks: Deep learning
Exercise sessions: Estimation theory
Exercise sessions: (Non)parametric hypothesis tests and variance analysis
Exercise sessions: Classification and cluster analysis
Exercise sessions: Biomedical image analysis
Exercise sessions: Time-series analysis
Exercise sessions: Machine learning challenge
assessment_rules: Partial or continuous assessment with a final exam during the examination period. Permitted materials include a list of formulas and a calculator.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
